actor_runtime: Fresh Codex collaboration agents with inherited model and settings; no per-arm override
actor_isolation: New scratch folders, identical actor prompt, task brief and original starter only, no post-dispatch implementation help
grading_isolation: Fresh grading-only Codex agents per task group, given anonymous images, briefs and redacted functional results. Each grader sees all requested anonymous pairings for its tasks without earlier scores.
execution_scope: Local worktree, local scratch files and bundled Codex subagents; no separate paid API or external publication
model_limits: Default Codex subagent service limits; no intervention or extra task-specific time budget
infrastructure_retry: Rerender the unchanged actor product after a proven runner failure, retaining prior evidence. Do not resample product failures.
baseline_checkout_note: The starting worktree is the local origin/main snapshot containing the release policy. The UX skill tree differs from the original main checkout by the 1.0.0 metadata field only.

original_checkout_archive.role: provenance only; the matching versioned worktree snapshot was the evaluated baseline
